personas.name: Covert Espionage Operative
personas.notes: High precision, prioritizes parries, disarm finishers, and cover-to-cover advances. Ideal for narrative espionage and action thrillers where repetitive firefights break immersion.

personas.name: Mythic Vanguard Mercenary
personas.notes: Designed for open-world action RPGs (e.g., Assassin's Creed Odyssey). Aggressive gap-closing, active parry-counters on enemy wind-up, and dynamic ability rotation.

personas.name: Battlefield Field Commander
personas.notes: Replaces naive 'F5 charge-nearest' bots in sandbox battle simulators with formation-aware positioning, directional blocking, and threat-weighted target selection.
